{{Quote|That is Senator Gunaray Dod. The great lout is more than ugly. He's corrupt right up to those tiny ears|Nalrin Daheel|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Gunaray Dod''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] statesman, Gunaray Dod served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] around [[3643 BBY]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era Senate, Dod was rumored to be linked to [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], paying criminals and thugs to harass his political rivals using rare [[Kavin bill]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

His fellow Senator [[Nalrin Daheel]] suspected him of corruption, and asked a traveling hero to venture into Black Sun territory to recover some of the rumored Kavin bills. The hero succeeded and gave the bills to Daheel, who planned to use them to prove Dod's corruption.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gunaray Dod appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the mission "Follow the Money".<ref name="TOR" />
